'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Jim Beyer DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Beyer]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jim Beyer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
